title: APIパラメータ・会話再生の有効性がモデル世代単位で変わり、呼び出し側を変えないモデル切替・Fallback・文脈編集が400や無言のBlock破棄で壊れる
summary: With Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 (2026-09-01), parameter validity and conversation-replay validity became model-generation-scoped: 'tool_choice types any and tool aren't supported and return a 400 error' (harnesses forcing tool use break on model upgrade with no caller change); 'Thinking blocks... are preserved only for the model that produced them or a newer one: earlier models can't read them, and the API drops one replayed to an earlier model' (silent content drop on model downgrade/fallback mid-conversation — the exact path overload fallbacks take); 'for new accounts created on or after August 31, 2026, replaying one after the system prompt, tools, or an earlier message changed returns a 400 error' (hard failure for harnesses that edit system prompts/tools mid-session, e.g. compaction, dynamic tool registration, turn-scoped instructions — and account-creation-date-conditional, so behavior differs across accounts running identical code). Related earlier instance: Opus 5 rejects thinking-disabled at effort xhigh/max (Claude Code itself shipped the client-side fix in v2.1.254). Mechanism: the same API version now enforces per-model-generation and per-account-cohort semantics, so mid-session model switching, fallback, and history/prompt mutation — standard coding-agent harness techniques — become version-skew failure surfaces. Adjacent to P-20260831-DE8D86E9 (beta→GA/SDK-major silent breakage) but the trigger is model selection, not API/SDK version; evaluate merge vs new at merge gate.

evidence.title: Claude Platform release notes 2026-09-01 (Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1)
evidence.summary: tool_choice any/tool → 400; thinking blocks unreadable by earlier models and dropped on downgrade replay; prefix-invariance 400 for accounts created ≥ 2026-08-31 when system/tools/messages changed before a replayed thinking block.

evidence.title: Claude Code v2.1.254
evidence.summary: 'Fixed Opus 5 requests failing when effort was xhigh/max with thinking disabled' — client-side fix for the same model-scoped parameter-validity divergence.
